requirements.requirement: On node1, run /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance daily at 02:15 and retain its output in /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log
requirements.summary: Root crontab entry '15 2 * * * /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance >> /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log 2>&1' was installed (cmd-b3191822a2e64622), matching the required 02:15 daily schedule and output-append target. The exact command line was manually executed to confirm it correctly creates/appends the log with the script's output (cmd-29a211f6aa4041b7). Pre-state confirmed no prior crontab/log existed (cmd-dde212b3a8674973), so this is a clean addition, not an overwrite of prior config. Post-restart verification (cmd-59504716552c4d2d) confirms the crontab entry, crond active+enabled state, and log file/contents all persisted, so the schedule will survive reboot as required for a durable cron job.

overall_summary: The executor correctly installed and verified a root cron job on node1 that runs /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance daily at 02:15 with output appended to /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log, matching the task contract exactly. The independently mandated node-restart evidence protocol was also completed end-to-end: healthy pre-restart baseline (boot_id 738d0aac..., crond active, crontab and log present), a reboot acknowledgement returned before disconnect, a distinct post-restart boot_id (2ab54a3e...) confirming an actual restart, and full recovery of crond, the crontab entry, and the log file/contents afterward.
limitations: Actual cron-triggered execution at 02:15 was not directly observed (session did not span a real 02:15 trigger); correctness was inferred from installing the exact crontab line and manually running the identical command, which is a reasonable proxy given time constraints.
Package-health checks were unavailable (timeout) at all three lifecycle snapshots, so package-manager consistency around the reboot could not be independently verified.

operational_hygiene.summary: All state-changing executor commands map cleanly to task or mandated restart-evidence purposes: crontab installation (cmd-b3191822a2e64622) satisfies the material outcome, the manual script run (cmd-29a211f6aa4041b7) is a bounded verification that also produced the log content later confirmed to survive reboot, and the reboot (cmd-32b57a9aebd34dbc) is the required node-restart evidence protocol. The reboot left a small residual /tmp/reboot.log from the backgrounded nohup redirect (visible in global:after_executor:node1:temporary-files), a low-risk, expected byproduct of the mandated restart procedure rather than an unnecessary mutation. No troubleshooting experiments, conflicting services, or unsafe exposure were observed; failed-services and listening-socket sets are unchanged in substance (only PIDs differ, consistent with the reboot).
